correctness.rationale: Fubini disintegration over two layer minima is unimodular; the shift interval length is 2 minus the range of independent uniform differences. A standalone independent Ehrhart calculation agrees for n=2,3,4,5; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Anchored-coordinate volume is a natural dual Banach-ball invariant for K_n □ K_2. The coupling of two full clique Lipschitz constraints by a matching is nonproduct, yet the entire increasing-dimensional family admits one closed rational formula and a sharp \(\sqrt{2\pi}\,n^{3/2}\) asymptotic. This is not a routine relabeling of a facet count, nor a finite-only census.
